name: Kirsa Bremer
source: A young girl who just graduated from high school and entered adulthood. She was sent by her mother to her uncle to find out how his things are going, since he hadn’t contacted them for 2 years. Now Kirsa will have to find out all the circumstances, meet new people and study the adult world in parallel.
